archive_readme:
# Source data for the 11 October 2026 production revision (v11b)

This archive records the promoted v14 manuscript, four main figures, 21
supplementary figures and Tables S1-S10 (57 data sheets, 200 blocks).
SOURCE-MANIFEST.tsv pins every file; restore project/ into the workspace.
The Sources worksheet records each block's input, filter and SHA-256 identity.

The unchanged 9 October source-data archive supplies retained historical inputs
and is required. COMPANION.json binds that identity. The additional_companions
in SOURCE-SELECTION.json bind Supplementary_Source_Code_v11b.zip and the original
Supplementary_Source_Code_S9.zip. Supply these archives together for reuse.

Candidate rendering receipts are retained as historical records. Production
file identities are given separately by Fig/figure-manifest.tsv. No scientific
analyses or historical figure rendering were rerun while packaging. Raw reads,
full training matrices and scientific runtime resources remain external.

This v11b snapshot supersedes v11a. Table S5d gains blocks S5d.6-S5d.8: the
12-setting matching grid, the random-priority same-gene and cross-gene
backgrounds, and the detection power of the matched-window test. Their three
source tables are archived here and are unchanged from the 9 October archive.
The related-figure letters of Tables S2f and S3h follow the relettered Figure 2.
Since v11a, the manuscript sources also carry the 11 October sentence-level
revisions, the revised main-figure captions and the updated archive names, and
Figures 1-4 carry the 11 October in-place label, lettering and color edits
recorded in Fig/figure-manifest.tsv. S1/S2 subsequently gained native state column IDs, with all numerical
values preserved. The other 19 supplementary figure assets are unchanged.

The final caption revision is recorded in
notes/2026-10-11-supplement-caption-revision/README.md. It defines state
codes, statistics and evidence tiers, and restores the sensitivity
pointer to Table S5d.6/S5d.7. The already verified 200-block workbook
is unchanged by this revision. New S1/S2 rendering receipts and values
are under that revision directory. Older candidate receipts retain
their original identity; Fig/figure-manifest.tsv pins production assets.
Packaging follows this rendering and does not rerun scientific analyses.

Figures 1-4 were revised in place after the main-figure caption review
(Figure 2 rows reordered to follow first citation, Figure 3 d/e swapped,
Figure 4 recoloured, label fixes). Values are unchanged. Edit receipts and
the record are in notes/2026-10-11-caption-figure-fixes/, and
Fig/figure-manifest.tsv pins the production assets.

License: the authors' code, configurations, processed source data and
documentation in this archive are released under the MIT License (LICENSE).
Third-party components keep their own terms (docs/third-party.md).

The reviewer-report revision of 11 October changed manuscript text only:
claim scope, the null-model definition (Supplementary Methods S1.8.5),
captions and terminology. It is recorded in
reviews/2026-10-11-reviewer-revision/REPORT.md.
Figures, workbook and code archive are unchanged.

A citation-source repair on 11-12 October kept miRBase release 22.1, as
pinned by the frozen input records, and relabeled the two GSE99922 MEF
libraries as control, following their GEO records. It is recorded in
reviews/2026-10-11-full-review-current/recheck-citation-sources/REPORT.md.
